lead: A `Core\Compress` fixture of one repeated byte is a decompression bomb by the class's own measure, so the *honest* half of a bound test is refused too.
body: Every codec here takes a buffer of one byte past `DEFAULT_MAX_RATIO`'s 1000:1 — 16 MiB of `A` comes back at 1027:1 — so a payload written to be easy to build fails the roomy call as well as the tight one, and reads as the member ignoring its defaults. Build the payload out of English text repeated, the way the `.nvst` cases in `tests/conformance/core/compress-*` already do.
